race.comment: ELLOFABY (7) is the immediate danger after missing by just over half a length at Kilcoy, with fitness on her side, though the 15-start maiden record keeps the price worth watching. STOLEN STOCK (3) resumes for Philip Minter, has trialled at Dalby two weeks ago and can improve sharply if returning in better order than his late-campaign Victorian form. FLYING VISION (8) was respected in an open Toowoomba market and was only beaten three and a half lengths, so she has enough recent substance to stay in the mix. TRUSTY FELINA (11) makes her debut with two trials and a strong jockey booking. Watch for any market confidence.
